decision: Cross-sectional top-1 leadership raises the removal minimum but still protects too many campaigns in union/common-five and lowers the primary mean-log wealth objective. Do not tune top-k, score margins or confirmation days.
research_boundary: Positive-alpha, price-above-basis, own-price-plus-alpha, standalone unified ownership, and top-1 funded-leader persistence have now all failed to beat the campaign-peak champion. Ownership hold/exit protection is no longer the highest-leverage research direction.
next_direction: Shift to a structurally different alpha-discovery and portfolio-construction engine: causal walk-forward expected trend continuation / relative return prediction plus dynamic capital concentration from predicted opportunity separation. Preserve the current campaign-peak champion as control, not as an architectural constraint.
evidence_readback: Dedicated hosted workflow completed TDD, source-bound measurement, artifact upload, research/evidence append and remote SHA read-back successfully.
